title: Jujutsu Kraft / Sorcerer Craft
description: A datapack heavily inspired by Jujutsu Kaisen!
body:
The datapack is full of jank, an unspeakable amount of spaghetti- but I present:

# **Jujutsukraft**

True to the show, you are either born blessed or not.
When you spawn in you are given a random cursed technique (or none!), a random cursed energy regeneration tier (as low as 20 CE a second, to as high as 600 CE a second!), and a random cursed energy amount!

If you are not born blessed then fret not, you can still crawl your way up the ladder!
By crafting Sukuna's fingers you can gain cursed energy (500 CE per finger, caps at 20 fingers) and at 15 you gain shrine!

For recovery you can craft Cursed Womb: Blood Paintings as a little snack. Your regeneration "tier" has a chance to increase every three Blood Paintings eaten, with a lower and lower chance per tier. (See gallery for recipes.) At nine paintings eaten you gain blood manipulation.

There are also binding vows you can use to exchange your resources for others.
(You can use 
```
/trigger jccmenu
```
 to check your stats or make binding vows.)

To see available techniques or more, I recommend checking out the [wiki](https://github.com/KenanTheFab/Jujutsukraft/wiki)! 

The short is:
- Blood Manipulation
- Limitless (No Infinity)
- Shrine
- Boogie Woogie
- Black Flash
- Domain Expansion (For Shrine and Limitless)
- Progression!
